description: Test suite for checking no accidental usage of os.tmpdir or tmpdir references in source files, verifying functions findMessagingTmpdirCallLines and messagingTmpdirGuardSourceRoots.

methods.name: findMessagingTmpdirCallLines
methods.description: Function to identify line numbers of calls to os.tmpdir() or tmpdir() in the source code.

methods.name: messagingTmpdirGuardSourceRoots
methods.description: Array containing source roots that are guarded against usage of host tmpdir calls.
